description: This file provides utilities for configuring Daily collaboration rooms and tokens, including creating new rooms with optional SIP support, handling existing rooms via environment variables, and managing token properties. It defines classes, functions, and dependencies specific to Daily's video API.

classes.name: DailyRoomConfig
classes.description: Represents the configuration of a Daily room, including the URL, token, and optional SIP endpoint.

methods.name: DailyRoomConfig configure( aiohttp_session: aiohttp.ClientSession, *, api_key: Optional[str] = None, room_exp_duration: Optional[float] = 2.0, token_exp_duration: Optional[float] = 2.0, sip_caller_phone: Optional[str] = None, sip_enable_video: Optional[bool] = False, sip_num_endpoints: Optional[int] = 1, sip_codecs: Optional[Dict[str, List[str]]] = None, room_properties: Optional[DailyRoomProperties] = None, token_properties: Optional["DailyMeetingTokenProperties"] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously creates or retrieves a Daily room and token, with optional SIP configuration. Handles existing room URLs via environment variable and creates new rooms with specified properties.
